description_en: Retrieves the real-time status of agents in batches based on agent IDs
description_zh: 根据座席工号批量获取座席实时状态
name: CloudBatchGetAgentStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The list of agent IDs. Separate multiple agent IDs with commas (,). Example: cnos=2000,2001. A maximum of 100 agents are supported
parameters.help_zh: 座席号列表；座席号之间用`,`分隔，如：cnos=2000,2001 最多支持100个座席
parameters.name: cnos

DeviceStatus.description_en:
The device status of the agent. This parameter is returned when the agent logon status is not offline. Valid values:
-1: Invalid status.
0: Idle.
1: Locked.
2: Inviting.
3: Ringing.
4: In use
DeviceStatus.description_zh: 座席设备状态，座席登录状态不是离线时返回  -1：错误的状态  0：空闲状态  1：锁定状态   2：邀请中状态  3：响铃状态  4：使用中状态
